method: HTTP 200 and exact SHA-256 match to the pinned deployed gh-pages artifact for all variants; separate byte comparison to local macOS Hugo output and pixel/visual review of any difference.

reviewedGenerationDifferences.visualReview: Both decoded images viewed at original size. Same app name, four mode labels, selected Conversation tab and Settings control. No missing text or changed operation/UI.
reviewedGenerationDifferences.disposition: Accepted after exact match to the deployed gh-pages artifact and visual/pixel review. Local macOS fresh generation reproduces its own bytes; byte-for-byte identity across generation environments is not claimed.
